key_reuse_findings: Y-star-gov already contains ystar.memory MemoryStore: SQLite-backed local long-term memory with decay, recall, reinforcement, and access log.
Y-star-gov CIEUStore is the formal durable evidence/memory store and remains mandatory for model-choice records.
Aiden 6D brain is the CEO cognition graph; E116/E118 provide governed brain-learning and owner/backup-gated production write boundaries.
CIEU-to-brain bridge and brain learning modules already map governance events into 6D activation and learning signals.
E24 and the knowledge/ceo corpus preserve older CEO knowledge graph, theory, wisdom, and operating-memory assets as historical context.
scripts/gemma_client.py contains a useful shadow-quality idea but remains quarantined because it can fall back to an external Claude API path.
reuse_conclusion: E123 does not create another memory database. It routes model/tool selection through existing CIEUStore, Aiden 6D brain, Y-star-gov MemoryStore, CIEU-to-brain bridge, governed brain-learning boundaries, and the file-backed CEO wisdom/theory corpus.
